STEP 1 - Scene: A small plated meal of roasted/fried potato-type pieces, likely sausages or small reddish-brown cooked items plus golden fried potato wedges, on a white square plate. Photographed from above, nearly top-down.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White square plate roughly 24 cm across (diagonal-free edge length ~22-24 cm). Using a ~22 cm effective diameter: area = 3.14 x (11)^2 ≈ 380 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Three reddish-brown roasted items (looks like small sausages or roasted potatoes with skin, ~5-6 cm long, ~3 cm wide each)
- Four to five golden fried/roasted potato wedges or chunks (~4 cm x 2.5 cm x 2 cm)

STEP 4 - Area: Reddish items together cover ~9% of plate (~35 cm^2). Golden potato pieces together cover ~12% (~45 cm^2). Total food covers ~21% of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Reddish items: 35 cm^2 x 2.5 cm ≈ 88 ml
- Golden potatoes: 45 cm^2 x 2.5 cm ≈ 113 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Reddish items (dense, meat-like sausage/roasted): 88 ml x 0.9 ≈ 79 g
- Potato pieces (cut, cooked): 113 ml x 0.6 ≈ 68 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Sausage-type items: 79 g x 300 kcal/100g ≈ 237 kcal
- Roasted/fried potato: 68 g x 150 kcal/100g ≈ 102 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Roughly 150 g of food covering about a fifth of a plate with 7-8 pieces is plausible for a small side-sized portion. Total ≈ 147 g, ≈ 339 kcal.
